generator_cmd: perl -e 'my $b=join "", map { sprintf "%07b", ord } split //, $ARGV[0]; $b.="0" x (-length($b) % 8); print unpack("H*", pack("B*", $b))' "$plain"  # perl pack 'B*' of %07b ASCII codes (8 chars = 7 octets)
oracle_cmd: python3 -I -c "import sys;h=sys.argv[1].replace(\" \",\"\");n=len(h)*4;b=format(int(h,16),\"0%db\"%n);print(\"\".join(chr(int(b[i:i+7],2)) for i in range(0,n-6,7)).rstrip(\"\\0\"))" "$encoded"  # python3 int(hex,16) bit string 7-bit groups
